_notes: attributes: which priority-group requirements this student satisfies.
ranking: the application list in preference order. Programs not listed are not applied to.
mark_twain_percentile: null = unknown, drawn uniformly each trial. Otherwise a number in [0,1] giving the student's expected rank among test-takers (0 = best). Set to 0.25 to model 'top quarter'.
lottery_number: known hex prefix of the DOE lottery number (first 1-4 characters is enough). null = draw randomly each trial.
mark_twain_sd: trial-to-trial noise on that percentile, so the two talent areas are correlated but not identical.
